## Record Identifier (RI)

CASE-2026-0142: minted at create time by the creating command (`mintIdentifier`), pattern travels with the value, NEVER edited or recycled. Generic — an invoice desk mints through the same field.

### Non-goals

No server-side sequence (the desk's App Configuration carries the counter; single-writer per realm is the recorded trade-off). Uniqueness is the minting command's job, not this field's.

cardInfo.name: Record Identifier
cardInfo.summary: The human-readable handle of a record — minted once, unique, never recycled.

attributes.cardDescription: A human-readable id such as CASE-2026-0142, minted once at create time from a pattern that travels with the value.
